title.narrative: KIP PMU stage I first tranche

description.narrative: The objective of this project is to convert two domestic refrigeration manufacturing lines at the enterprise MANAR from HFC-134a to R-600a to eliminate 25.65 metric tonnes (mt) (36,684 CO2 equivalent tonnes (CO2 eq tonnes)) of HFC-134a consumption (2023 consumption) and to provide assistance Moroccan strategy for the implementation of the Kigali amendment until 2045, which includes HFC phase-down and improvement of energy efficiency in the relevant sectors.
